posts.text:
Hilton Head Island is not just a destination. It is home to thousands of South Carolinians with real needs and real priorities.

Our office met with Communications Director Heather Woolwine to discuss key issues like workforce, housing, childcare, and the Hilton Head Island bridge.

The Lowcountry’s priorities are our priorities.

South Carolina STRONG.

As Republicans, it is important for us to hold people accountable, no matter their position or party.

We trust President Trump’s judgment and decision-making. He has done a fantastic job so far leading us in the right direction.

Video
Lindsey Graham should stop fantasizing about war and pass the SAVE America Act in the Senate.

Lindsey Graham wants American troops on the ground in Iran. Not his kids. Yours. Not for freedom. But for the price of oil. 

Unless he's suiting up for Kharg Island himself, he should sit down.
Are you willing for your kid to die to lower the price of oil?

Iwo Jima cost 6,821 American lives.


NewsWire (@NewsWire_US)

Lindsey Graham on Iran's Kharg Island: "We did Iwo Jima. We can do this."







— https://nitter.net/NewsWire_US/status/2035754177436041531#m

Lindsey Graham has one foreign policy: send someone else's kids to war.

He was wrong about Iraq.
He was wrong about Afghanistan.
Now he's wrong about Iran.

Lindsey Graham needs to be removed from the Situation Room. 

I don't want to hear one word from a guy with no kids, desperately sending our sons and daughters into war on the ground in Iran.

The Save America Act is about protecting the future of our country.

If election fraud continues and illegal immigrants are allowed to vote, real Americans are being silenced. Every fraudulent ballot cancels out a citizen. Every illegal vote takes away a citizen’s voice. This is not complicated. This is not a conspiracy. This is happening right now.

It needs to stop. Pass the Save America Act.

President Trump is executing the operation in Iran with strength and precision.

He doesn't make empty threats, he makes promises and comes good on them. We need to get in, do what's necessary to ensure Iran never gets its hands on a nuclear weapon, and get out without endless wars or boots on the ground.

Video

We helped secured $500,000 in DOJ funding for Hopeful Horizons, a Lowcountry nonprofit dedicated every day to survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault.

This funding expands legal services across the Lowcountry by developing legal programs to provide real protection in the hands of survivors exactly when they need it most.

No survivor should have to navigate the legal system alone. No survivor should have to choose between safety and affordability.

Hopeful Horizons is changing lives,

Our office attended the MUSC Health Primary Care Ribbon Cutting in St. George. 

This is a huge win for the Lowcountry, more healthcare access in a rural area where it's needed most. Families shouldn't have to drive an hour for a doctor's appointment or skip care because it's too far away. This clinic brings primary care closer to home. Rural South Carolinians deserve accessible, quality healthcare.

South Carolina STRONG.

Tim Walz may have struggled with this question, even after he had nine months to study, but South Carolinians know what a woman is.

Video

We introduced the Childhood Genital Mutilation Prevention Act because children deserve protection, not experimentation. A child cannot consent to the permanent, irreversible destruction of their own body.

Our bill criminalizes these procedures on minors, strips federal funding, and removes Medicare participation from any provider who performs them.

Your child is not a science experiment.

We introduced the Making Homeownership Affordable Again Act to completely eliminate capital gains taxes on the sale of primary residences and any home sold to a first-time homebuyer, expanding opportunities for first-time homebuyers, allowing seniors and empty nesters to downsize, and helping more families achieve the American dream of homeownership. 

South Carolina is the fastest-growing state in the country, and our families need real solutions to make housing affordable again. 

READ MORE: m

INTRODUCING: The Incentivizing Cooperation in Immigration Enforcement Act.

This bill will make sure localities cooperating with federal immigration enforcement get priority consideration for federal law enforcement grants.

We should reward localities who cooperate with DHS to remove criminal illegal immigrants from our communities, not those who actively obstruct immigration enforcement.
Bombing Iran with one hand and buying Iran oil with the other.

Our office attended the ribbon cutting for Balanced Wellness, a new wellness and healthcare facility.

Their expanded space will allow them to serve more patients and provide vital psychological support for women facing maternal mental health challenges, including infertility, miscarriage, and postpartum mood disorders, struggles often left unspoken.

This team is showing up in a real, meaningful way and will be a true asset for women and families across the Lowcountry.

South Carolina STRONG.

When we stand for the American flag, we are not standing for politicians or parties. We are standing for the brave men and women in uniform who serve and who have served this nation.

Our veterans deserve every promise kept. The best health care. The strongest benefits. The full support and resources of the country they defended. They earned it through service, sacrifice, and courage. We owe them nothing less.

Video

We spoke this week at the Low Country Retired Law Enforcement Officers Association meeting in Bluffton. We were able to meet and speak with many of our community’s heroes.

Decades of service. A lifetime of sacrifice. Every single one of them deserving of our deepest respect and appreciation.

These are the brave men and women who make South Carolina STRONG.
